status: locked_before_model_evaluation; first execution superseded by implementation split bug

dataset.name: Gas Sensor Array Drift Dataset
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0; source page excludes commercial use in its dataset description, follow the more restrictive research-only condition
dataset.acquisition_order: batch IDs 1-10 are coarse collection cohorts; no within-cohort timestamps are modeled

admission.exact_duplicate_rows: audit and report; do not deduplicate silently
admission.cohort_coverage: report per-class counts and proportions for every batch

historical_split.allocation: stratified 60% training, 20% calibration, 20% reference; first hold out 40%, then split that remainder equally
historical_split.monitoring_cohorts: whole batches 2-10, never used for fitting, calibration, reference, or protocol selection

model.name: multinomial LogisticRegression
model.scaler: StandardScaler fit on training partition only
model.calibration: one-dimensional fixed LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=2000) mapping max class probability to correctness, fit on calibration partition only
model.representations: three-component PCA fit on standardized training partition only

monitoring.input_tests: two-sided KS per original feature plus three frozen PCA scores, Holm correction within each cohort; alpha 0.05
monitoring.impact: mean calibrated correctness probability; continuity-corrected normal approximation to the plug-in Poisson-binomial 95% predictive interval
monitoring.uncertainty: use normal approximation with sum(q_i) and sum(q_i(1-q_i)) and continuity correction; report per-cohort realized proportion and interval; summarize coverage over nine cohorts descriptively only; no independent replication or known onset recall claim
monitoring.composition: report class counts/proportions and state that composition change contributes to aggregate accuracy change

deviations: External extension is multi-class and cohort-level; it does not simulate within-batch online timestamps or delayed label arrival.
Batch 1 is only 445 rows, so the predeclared stratified historical partitions are small; results are an admission-limited evaluation.
This UCI page says research use only; no commercial use is claimed.
selection_rule: No monitoring outcome, detector result, or model score was inspected when the split, model, calibration, thresholds, or metrics were fixed.
